PLUGIN.NAME: Memos
PLUGIN.DESCRIPTION: Imports Memos with checkboxes as tasks and syncs task notes with Memos.

CFG.FILTER_TAG_HELP: Without #, e.g. "work". Empty: all memos with checkboxes.
CFG.FILTER_SPACE_HELP: e.g. "team" or "spaces/team". The Memos URL and access token are set in the plugin settings (gear icon in Settings → Plugins).
CFG.INCLUDE_COMPLETED: Also offer memos whose checkboxes are all checked
CFG.TITLE_MODE_HELP: How the task title is built from the memo
CFG.TITLE_MODE_CASCADE: Smart: single open checkbox, else text before the first checkbox, else generic

SUBTASKS.DIALOG_TEXT: Selected checkboxes become subtasks. Completing a subtask checks the box in Memos and vice versa.
SUBTASKS.NONE_LEFT: This memo has no open checkboxes without a subtask
SUBTASKS.ONLY_MEMO_TASKS: Only available for tasks imported from Memos
SUBTASKS.CHECKBOX_GONE: Memos: The checkbox of this subtask no longer exists in the memo

SYNC.CONFLICT_COMMENT: Older version, replaced during a sync conflict with Super Productivity:
SYNC.CONFLICT_SNACK: Memos: notes of "{{title}}" changed on both sides. The older version is kept as a comment on the memo.
SYNC.DISABLED: Memos: note sync is turned off in the plugin settings

ERRORS.NO_BASE_URL: Memos: please set the Memos URL in the plugin settings (gear icon in Settings → Plugins)
ERRORS.BLOCKED_HOST: Memos: Super Productivity blocks private IP addresses and localhost for plugins. Please use a host name in the Memos URL (e.g. https://memos.home.lan).
ERRORS.AUTH: Memos: access denied. Please check the access token in the plugin settings (gear icon in Settings → Plugins).

SETTINGS.TITLE: Memos settings
SETTINGS.baseUrl_HINT: e.g. https://memos.home.lan. Use a host name: Super Productivity blocks private IP addresses and localhost for plugins (a host name resolving to a LAN address works). In the web version, Memos must allow CORS.
SETTINGS.token_HINT: Create it in Memos under Settings → My account → Access tokens. Stored on this device only, never synced.
SETTINGS.token_PLACEHOLDER_SET: Stored on this device. Paste a new one to replace it
SETTINGS.noteSyncEnabled_HINT: Each task with notes gets its own memo. Tasks imported from Memos and checkbox subtasks are left out.
SETTINGS.syncTag_HINT: Without #. Memos with this tag are never offered as tasks.
SETTINGS.pullIntervalMinutes: Check Memos for changes every … minutes
SETTINGS.pullIntervalMinutes_HINT: Additionally whenever the app window gets focus.
SETTINGS.onTaskDelete: When a task with a note memo is deleted
SETTINGS.syncOtherProviderTasks: Also sync notes of tasks from other issue providers (GitHub, …)
SETTINGS.spBaseUrl: Super Productivity URL for task links (optional)
SETTINGS.spBaseUrl_HINT: The task title in each note memo links to the task. Empty: the address of the web app in use. The desktop app has no web address; set it there if you also use a web instance.
